sources.semantic_mapping: spikeInfo2npy lines204-283: HDF5 references; waveform transpose; original unit order; sessions contiguous positive; channel geometry/shank first-unit references; optional PETH. Preprocess computes AutoCorr and ISI only when used by motion/clustering; optional PETH copied.
PETH included in motion and shared-motion defaults; Waveform/AutoCorr used in final clustering. PETH excluded from all paths for independent PETH comparison.

same-session collisions removed; singletons -1; all same-cluster unordered pairs counted; directional session fractions use source-session unit denominator. Output.npz stores object dictionary, so numerical arrays preferred for safe ingestion.
multishank output restores original indices; positive cluster labels offset, -1 unmatched; cross-shank matrix zeros uncomputed, not dissimilarity.

Comparison excludes PETH throughout pipeline, shares well-isolated populations and defaults; UnitMatch requires half-session waveforms. PETH similarity is Fisher z of Pearson r for concatenated press/release/poke ±500ms windows,1ms bins. Two rats historically truncated31sessions after OOM; do not silently import truncation. Indirect functional evidence is not universal true identity.

Independent final review: Figure 5E uses consecutive recording DAYS, firing-rate eligibility (mean >=1Hz and peak >=5Hz), common support >=100 valid pairs across three methods, median and Friedman statistics. Figure 5F/G unmatched-pair outlier analysis uses >50 micrometer Gaussian null and 20 micrometer bins. These paper endpoints are NOT reconstructed by this all-pair mean diagnostic; day/eligibility/three-method/EMD/native coverage remain holds.

prospective_choices.population: All 13 released datasets, all original units/sessions. Native quality filtering compatibility remains unresolved; no selected-unit intersection.
prospective_choices.grouping: Operator must bind dataset IDs to verified biological-animal metadata; Ekko and Punch regions cannot be separated. Regional metrics average within animal, then animals average equally.
prospective_choices.yield: Mean over ordered distinct session pairs within dataset; zero matches gives zero. Dataset and biological-animal averages are explicit prospective summaries, not saved paper numeric targets.
prospective_choices.functional: All unordered pairs within positive tracks, once each. Constant vectors undefined with counts. Correlations within eight float64 epsilons of +/-1 snap to signed infinity; stable pre-scaling before centering avoids overflow. This explicit numerical policy is prospective, not source-specified.
prospective_choices.boundary: Operator-controlled protected packet; complete settings and PETH exclusions attested and recursively checked. No executable provenance or secrecy inferred from JSON declarations.
prospective_choices.reward: No binary reward, calibrated neuron identity probability, or scientific pass/fail.
